scope: Guarded List name/notes/color/icon edits with whole-patch conflict rejection, original receipt replay and typed mixed-source independent recovery.

Red.failure: List editing rejects as unavailable before implementation.

observations: Public read/execute/reopen returns edited notes, unchanged List metadata, empty derived progress and the original checkpoint on exact replay.

An intervening name edit does not invalidate a notes-only edit using the full old hash map. A conflicting notes field rejects an entire name/notes patch with typed current values/hashes and no timestamp/checkpoint change.
Later notes are retained when replaying an old successful edit. Unused echoed hashes do not enlarge the payload; modified content under the old operation ID rejects.

Exact padded Unicode name and empty notes/icon survive before optional clears. The blue color hash is checked against literal accepted canonical bytes with only real UUID contexts substituted. Unrelated Item/Schedule hashes and Item updatedAt remain unchanged.
Ten invalid typed edits and a missing identity have no applied evidence; a real recovery-directory file obstruction rejects before committing.
Two independently bootstrapped facades compete on one original notes guard at the shared native writer boundary; one saves at checkpoint 2 and one rejects stale.
limits: No native saved List editor, memberships, List archive action or HTTP List admission is qualified here.
No schema or portable-format change; genuine migration fixtures remain covered by the affected store regression.
No prepared-content inspection, postcommit interruption, actual Share extension, physical iCloud/account convergence or performance claim.
ReadLoadTests is excluded from this affected MCP regression. Simulator is compilation only.
